description.value: Yuu Japanese Tapas is a contemporary Japanese restaurant in Richmond serving mini hotpots, okonomiyaki, donburi, and signature ramen made from a scratch broth prepared daily by the head chef. The restaurant offers a family-friendly dine-in atmosphere alongside takeout and delivery, with a kids menu and party tray catering options rounding out a broad menu. It has been featured in local press and positions itself as a destination for quality Japanese cuisine in Richmond's Sexsmith Road area.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack at 49m; rack at 78m; rack at 86m; rack at 93m.
